positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build and maintain backend microservices for analytical data processing, client permissions, and auditing systems, which are critical infrastructure for our research teams and the front-end engineering team. Collaborating on a team of about 6 engineers, architect and build systems that are well-tested, monitored, and maintainable. Respond to incidents on production systems and diagnose issues raised by internal users.

Consolidated data-labelling pipelines of a dozen research teams into a single platform. This platform enabled label sharing across teams, rapid testing of new datasets, and tagging execution within a secure third-party environment. Worked on all  components included REST APIs, a Vue.js-based UI, a Spark application , and a custom orchestration layer. Practiced code review, sprint planning, and pair programming. Wrote our unit and integration tests.

Maintain data pipelines built with Apache Spark and Airflow. Researched use cases for DNS-based data. Developed internal APIs using Serverless and AWS. Managed ETL of data from S3 to Snowflake.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
Under Analyst Troy Li, I help prepare and publish equity research based on alternative data, covering major restaurants and grocers. Right now this includes:
- Analyzing consumer spending, weather, and web-scaped data to estimate revenue trends and produce useful insights for investors.
- Designing and implementing software to automate and improve the analysis process

positions.title: Student Body Webmaster
positions.description:
Maintained and expanded Django-based web application. Optimized single transferable vote algorithm for elections application.
Maintained the entire stack, including hardware, Linux (Ubuntu Server), Apache, PostgreSQL, Django, and front-end Javascript.
Coordinated with student government to plan online elections and design application updates.

positions.title: SAPR Advocate Coordinator
positions.description: Scheduled support line, helped trained advocates, and coordinated community outreach events, in addition to working as an advocate myself.

positions.title: News and Design Editor
positions.description:
Published over 40 weekly newspapers, researched and wrote 13 news articles, and edited submissions to the paper.
Designed paper with Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop and maintained Wordpress-based website, reedquest.org.
Cooperated with three other editors on the editorial board to recruit and mentor writers, deliberate on ethical issues we faced, and to develop systems to meet strict weekly deadlines and improve publication quality.

positions.title: SAPR Advocate
positions.description: Under the Sexual Assault Prevention and Response (SAPR) program. Attended two 40 hours trainings on sexual and relationship violence prevention and response. Coordinated and was on-call for the crisis line, which provides a confidential way for survivors or friends of survivors of sexual and/or relationship violence to get emotional support and information on what service from the college they could benefit from.

positions.title: Javascript Development Intern
positions.description:
Wrote a Node.js-based web scraper to collect over 140,000 business leads.
Co-wrote an in-house D3.js-based charting library for use in customer-facing analytics dashboard.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Mathematics with a Concentration in Statistics

projects.title: Multilevel Models and Missing Data Models for Crowdsourced Bicycle Route Ratings (Undergrad. Thesis)
projects.description: Given a set of commuter bike routes and binary ratings of those routes, can we infer which streets are contributing most to cyclists' negative experience on their commutes? This is the hope of Knock Software's Ride Report app. My thesis seeks to start to build a probabilistic model to solve this problem, using random intercept models to model riders' different perceptions of rating criteria and a version of the EM algorithm to account for potential bias in which rides are given a rating.
